audit_metadata.audit_title: Independent Numerical & Cryptographic Audit of Accuracy Optimization Study
audit_metadata.status: Completed - All Numerical & Methodological Issues Systematically Resolved

evidence_table.claim: Proposed Combined Model achieves 65.52% test accuracy on Seed 42, but Seed 42 in the multi-seed table reports 58.98%.
evidence_table.verification_procedure: Executed scripts/audit_numerical_reconciliation.py (task-2424) comparing: (A) fresh np.random.seed(42) with plaintext FedAvg, (B) fresh np.random.seed(42) with Paillier SecAgg, and (C) sequential PRNG execution offset following Steps 1-6.
evidence_table.verdict: PARTIALLY INVALID / DISCREPANCY RESOLVED. The two metrics were generated under different PRNG offset states and protocols. Step 7 (65.52%) ran after ~1,500 unseeded random draws, discovering an unusually favorable SGD path. Phase 5 explicitly reset np.random.seed(42) at line 311 and used use_secagg=False, generating 58.98% (replicated as 59.54%-59.86%). Across multiple seeds (42: 58.98%, 100: 63.37%, 2026: 65.20%), the true expected accuracy is 62.52% ± 3.20% (ddof=1).
evidence_table.required_correction: Never present 65.52% as a reproducible single-seed deterministic result or conflate it with the multi-seed table. Report 65.52% strictly as a single-run high-water mark under PRNG drift, and report 62.52% ± 3.20% (s, N=3) as the primary evaluation metric.

evidence_table.claim: Plaintext FedProx achieves 76.46% while Paillier Encrypted FedProx achieves 75.34% (apparent 1.12% accuracy penalty).
evidence_table.verification_procedure: Ran an 8-round controlled side-by-side audit (scripts/audit_numerical_reconciliation.py) fixing identical model initialization, identical client partitioning, identical mini-batch shuffling per client, and direct round-by-round vector subtraction: plain_delta vs. decrypted_delta.
evidence_table.verdict: FALSE CLAIM / ZERO ACCURACY PENALTY CONFIRMED. The 1.12% gap in the benchmark script was an artifact of inter-step PRNG mutation in sequential execution. Under identical aggregation inputs, round-by-round vector difference was strictly bounded by 4.85e-7 (mean error 1.36e-7) due to 10^6 fixed-point scaling. Both plaintext and Paillier models reached exactly 60.0958% test accuracy (Accuracy delta = 0.0000%).
evidence_table.required_correction: Explicitly state in reports that Paillier additive homomorphic encryption achieves exact numerical equivalence with plaintext averaging down to float precision, with 0.0000% accuracy loss under controlled conditions.

evidence_table.claim: Hyperparameter optimization used strict validation sets without data leakage into the final test set.
evidence_table.verification_procedure: Audited data partitioning pipelines. Confirmed total 6,264 samples: Full Train = 5,011 (80%), Test = 1,253 (20%). In tuning script, Full Train was split into Subtrain = 4,008 (80%) and Validation = 1,003 (20%). Checked class distributions and verified PowerTransformer fitting scope.
evidence_table.verdict: VERIFIED / ZERO DATA LEAKAGE. The held-out test set (1,253 samples) was completely excluded from tune_continuous_fl.py (not even returned by load_and_split_subtrain_val). PowerTransformer was fit strictly on subtrain data during tuning, and strictly on full train data during final benchmarking.
evidence_table.required_correction: Clearly disclose sample counts in documentation: Subtrain = 4,008, Validation = 1,003, Held-out Test = 1,253. Document that validation tuning accuracy is reported separately from held-out test accuracy.

evidence_table.claim: Differential privacy provides mathematically verified privacy with epsilon = 10,678.61 for C=5.0, sigma=0.02, T=8.
evidence_table.verification_procedure: Recomputed RDP Gaussian mechanism composition over T=8 rounds, sensitivity C=5.0, noise std = 0.10 (multiplier 0.02), delta=1e-5. Evaluated both analytical continuous minimum and 50,000-point numerical grid search.
evidence_table.verdict: NUMERICALLY VERIFIED BUT SCOPE QUALIFIED. Analytical optimal alpha = 1.033931 yields epsilon = 10,678.61. However: (1) The guarantee is strictly Client-Level DP, bounding hospital client delta updates; (2) Record-Level DP is unverified and unbounded because local Adam SGD does not clip individual patient samples; (3) epsilon ≈ 10,679 is empirical gradient perturbation against model inversion, not strong information-theoretic differential privacy.
evidence_table.required_correction: Formally label the mechanism as Client-Level Empirical DP / Gradient Perturbation. Explicitly disclose that Record-Level DP is unverified and that epsilon ≈ 10,679 is not strong formal privacy.

evidence_table.claim: Paillier 512-bit PHE is cryptographically sufficient and NIST-compliant.
evidence_table.verification_procedure: Cross-referenced NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5 recommendations for integer factorization and evaluated Decisional Composite Residuosity Assumption (DCRA) hardness.
evidence_table.verdict: FALSE CLAIM / PROTOCOL LIMITATION. NIST SP 800-57 does not mention Paillier by name, but mandates modulus length >= 2048 bits for 112-bit security by integer factorization hardness equivalence. 512-bit Paillier provides < 64 bits of security and is strictly a prototype setting to prevent interactive execution timeouts.
evidence_table.required_correction: Mark 512-bit Paillier as a research prototype only. Document that production deployment requires >= 2048-bit modulus under NIST integer factorization equivalence.
